Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Chief Executive Officer (CEO): Degree in Naval Architecture Engineering/Marine Engineering/Ocean Engineering/ Mechanical Engineering from a recognized University AND PhD in Engineering from a recognized University. Minimum of 25 years of managerial experience in Ship design/ Shipyard/ R&D organisations with proven track record of managing large projects or leading operations in senior/leadership positions in Commercial or Defence R&D/Design/Shipbuilding/Maritime sector.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the ISTC CEO recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your online application for the ISTC Chief Executive Officer (CEO) position is 28th September 2026. Ensure your application is submitted before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the CEO post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Degree in Naval Architecture Engineering/Marine Engineering/Ocean Engineering/Mechanical Engineering and a PhD in Engineering from a recognized university. Significant managerial experience is also required.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Chief Executive Officer position?
faq.answer: The age limit for the Chief Executive Officer (CEO) post is between a minimum of 50 years and a maximum of 62 years, as of 18th September 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the CEO role?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Chief Executive Officer (CEO) position will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 3,00,000/- per month.

faq.question: Q5. How many vacancies are available for the CEO post?
faq.answer: There is only one vacancy available for the Chief Executive Officer (CEO) position in the India Ship Technology Centre (ISTC) recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee for the ISTC CEO recruitment?
faq.answer: The application fee for General/OBC and PwBD candidates is ₹ 400/-. SC/ST candidates are exempted from paying any application fee.

faq.question: Q7. What is the mode of application for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application process for the ISTC Chief Executive Officer (CEO) recruitment is strictly online. Candidates need to apply through the official website.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for the CEO post?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Chief Executive Officer (CEO) post will involve a Personal Interview followed by Certificate Verification.

faq.question: Q9. Is this a permanent or contractual job?
faq.answer: The recruitment for the Chief Executive Officer (CEO) post at ISTC is on a contractual basis.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The official notification PDF can be downloaded from the Important Links section of this article. It contains all the detailed information regarding the recruitment.
